description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and locates config at skills/fork-manager/repos/numcore/config.json. 
2. Agent reads history.md (doesn't exist — creates it with header). 
3. Agent runs 'full-sync' workflow: fetches upstream + origin remotes. 
4. SYNC: merges upstream/main into local main, pushes to origin/main (2 commits ahead). 
5. UPDATE-CONFIG: runs `gh pr list --state open --author @me` → gets PRs #101 and #103. Detects PR #103 is in notes.droppedPatches → PROPRIETARY TRAP: must restore #103 to openPRs and prBranches, remove from droppedPatches (this is the 'PR reopened' detection logic unique to the skill). 
6. REVIEW-CLOSED: detects PR #102 is not in gh open list but is in openPRs → queries gh pr view 102 → state=CLOSED. Per task instruction to keep closed PRs as local patches: removes #102 from openPRs and prBranches, adds it to localPatches with a 'local/' prefix branch key and required metadata fields (originalPR: 102, closedReason, keepReason, addedAt, reviewDate). 
7. REBASE-ALL: rebases fix/sparse-solver, fix/memory-leak (PR #103), and local/precision-fix onto upstream/main using --force-with-lease. 
8. BUILD-PRODUCTION: creates main-with-all-prs from upstream/main; merges open PR branches in ascending order (#101 fix/sparse-solver, #103 fix/memory-leak), then local patches (local/precision-fix, and the new local patch from #102 feat/gpu-backend or local/gpu-backend); pushes with --force-with-lease. 
9. Writes history.md with the required append-only format: --- separator, ## YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC | full-sync header, Summary/Actions Taken/Pending/Full Report sections. 
10. PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) PR reopened detection must look in notes.droppedPatches and restore automatically; (b) localPatches keys must use 'local/' prefix per naming convention; (c) production branch order is open PRs ascending first, then local patches; (d) must use --force-with-lease not --force; (e) history.md is append-only with exact separator format.
